title: The Sock Heel Will Not Stay Flat
premise: While folding clean laundry at an ordinary parked stop, one traveler smooths a sock heel that keeps turning sideways. The close-up repeats until the sock is folded with the heel still slightly crooked.

title: The Care Tag Has Nothing New to Say
premise: We turn over one familiar shirt to read its care tag, then turn it back and read the same line again. The instructions are unchanged and the shirt remains unfolded beside the camera.

title: The Cuff Is Still Damp
premise: After a routine wash, a shirt hangs on a portable rack at a parked stop while the camera checks one cuff at three ordinary intervals. It goes from damp to less damp, with no larger development.

title: Folding the Empty Laundry Bag Again
premise: An empty laundry bag is folded into a flat rectangle, opened to check its shape, and folded once more. The final version is almost exactly the first one.

title: The T-Shirt Fold Needs One More Try
premise: A traveler folds one clean T-shirt, notices that one sleeve sticks out, and starts over with the same shirt. The camera gives both attempts equal time, though the second rectangle is only a little neater.

title: Three Hangers Face the Same Direction
premise: After putting away a few clean shirts, a traveler turns three empty hangers to face the same way. One is nudged out of line and then put back.

title: Two Shirts Dry at Different Speeds
premise: A cotton shirt and a synthetic layer hang side by side on a portable rack during the same stop. The synthetic is dry before lunch. The cotton is still damp when it's time to go.

title: A Small Shirt Wash, From Basin to Rack
premise: A traveler hand-washes a single shirt in a clean basin, rinses it, and hangs it on a portable rack. Laundry day, cut down to fit a rest stop.

title: Fold Some Clothes, Hang the Rest
premise: After a small wash, the clean clothes get split into what stacks flat and what only behaves on a hanger. It's the closest the trunk has come to having a closet.

title: The Missing Sock Finally Catches Up at Wash Day
premise: One clean sock rides folded in the unmatched pile through several wash days. When its partner finally turns up in a later load, the reunion gets a slow close-up before they're folded together for tomorrow.
